title: Ensure SSH access is limited
implementation_task: Configure sshd_config permissions and access controls
justification: Prevents unauthorized remote access and lateral movement.

title: Ensure SSH Protocol is set to 2
Disable IP forwarding
implementation_task: Configure sysctl to set net.ipv4.ip_forward to 0
justification: Prevents the server from acting as a router between networks.

title: Ensure source routed packets are not accepted
justification: Stops attackers from specifying routing paths for packets.

title: Configure PAM password complexity
justification: Enforces strong passwords to prevent credential compromise.

title: Disable unused filesystem types
threat_mapping: Privilege escalation via unusual filesystem modules
implementation_task: Blacklist cramfs, freevxfs, jffs2, hfs, hfsplus
justification: Reduces kernel attack surface by disabling unneeded filesystems.

title: Ensure service xinetd is not enabled
justification: Minimizes running background services that can be exploited.

title: Ensure time synchronization is configured
justification: Ensures accurate timestamps for log correlation and forensics.

title: Ensure auditd is installed and enabled
justification: Provides critical tracking of security-relevant events.

title: Ensure audit log retention is configured
threat_mapping: Log deletion and lack of log retention
implementation_task: Configure max_log_file and action_keep_logs in auditd.conf
justification: Ensures historical security logs are preserved for analysis.

title: Ensure UFW firewall is installed and active
threat_mapping: Exposed database services and open ports
implementation_task: Install and enable UFW with default deny incoming policy
justification: Restricts network exposure to only authorized ports.

title: Ensure permissions on /etc/passwd are configured
justification: Prevents unauthorized tampering with user accounts.

title: Ensure permissions on /etc/shadow are configured
threat_mapping: Credential theft and offline password cracking
justification: Protects password hashes from unprivileged users.

title: Ensure system account default shell is restricted
justification: Prevents system accounts from launching interactive shells.

title: Ensure TCP SYN Cookies are enabled
justification: Protects the system against SYN flood denial of service attacks.
